messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — I'm proposing we reserve 40 A100 GPUs in us-west1 for 12 months to support next-quarter inference demand. Quick sketch below, need budget + PO signoff.

marta: Cost calc (rough):
```
on-demand: $2.50/hr * 24 * 30 * 40 = $72,000/month
12mo reserved (~30% off): $50,400/month
Estimated net savings: ~$21.6k/month (~$259k/yr)
Commit term = 12 months, start target = 2024-06-01
```

marta: Link to perf heatmap + expected qps: https://redwood.internal/costs/gpu-reservations (internal)

nina (finance): Thanks Marta — a few asks before we can sign off: cost center to charge, confirmed start date, and the amortized monthly cost in our ledger format. Also need expected utilization and a contingency plan if usage <60%.

asim: Utilization assumptions: we expect steady-state 80-85% avg inference utilization after rollout (baseline right now is ~62% across clusters). We ran a simulation for batch sizes and latency — reserving 40 moves tail-latency SLO from ~220ms -> ~160ms for peak windows. If utilization dips below 60% we can re-route non-critical workloads to spot/ondemand and throttle batch sizes.

denny: FYI — us-west1 has zone-level GPU quotas. We can't put all 40 in one zone; plan to spread across 3 zones. Also need to confirm network egress limits for model shards — NLB throughput per VM might be the blocker for some large models. I'll run a quick quota check and post results.

eric: Procurement note: I can open the PO once finance gives the cost center and approval text. Do we want 12mo CU (Committed Use) via GCP or a multi-year reserved contract through our channel partner? 36mo gets better discount (~45%) but longer lock. Which do you prefer?

marta: Prefer 12mo for flexibility given model roadmap. If we still need capacity after 6mo we can convert to 36/term or buy additional reserved capacity. Also prefer GCP CU to keep management simple.

nina (finance): OK — conditional approval:
- Cost center: INFRA-ENG-2024-Q2
- Funds: block $605k of capex across FY24/Q3 and amortize monthly
- Reporting: weekly utilization dashboard to finance for first 3 months
- Tags: all reserved instances must have cost-center tags and team owner
Once we get the formal utilization plan + denny's quota check we can sign.

billing-bot: Projection snapshot generated: https://redwood.internal/billing/forecasts/1712104321 — shows 12mo reserved lowers runrate by ~30% vs on-demand across Q3/Q4.

asim: I'll assemble a one-pager with utilization sims, risk matrix (underutilization, region outage, network limits) and a fallback playbook (route to on-demand, scale down batch sizes, pause non-critical pipelines). ETA EOD tomorrow.

denny: Quota check: us-west1 zones us-west1-a/b/c available quota per zone: 16 GPUs free in a, 12 in b, 20 in c (as of check). We'll need to request quota bump to land 40 quickly or stage across both providers. Filing quota ticket now.

eric: Great — once finance posts the approval text here I'll start the GCP CU purchase flow and attach PO. If quota bump is slow we can do a staged rollout (20 reserved, then top up).

marta: Sounds good. Action items: asim — one-pager util + playbook (EOD tomorrow); denny — quota ticket + network check (today); eric — ready to open PO once nina confirms final approval string; nina — confirm when ledger entry is created.

nina (finance): I'll create ledger entry INFRA-ENG-2024-Q2 by tomorrow morning and post the approval note. :thumbsup:

marta: Thanks all — tagging @eric @denny @asim to keep momentum.
